# Forter
> AI-powered fraud prevention, identity intelligence, and payment decisioning for digital commerce.

Forter helps merchants, marketplaces, and financial institutions reduce fraud, approve more legitimate customers, and optimize payment performance using a global identity network and real-time decisioning.

## Product
- [Trust Platform](https://www.forter.com/platform/): Overview of Forter’s unified platform for identity, fraud, and payment decisions.
- [Identity Intelligence](https://www.forter.com/platform/identity-intelligence/): Identity graph and intelligence capabilities used to recognize legitimate users and detect risk.
- [Fraud Management](https://www.forter.com/platform/fraud-management/): Fraud prevention capabilities across account, transaction, and abuse-related risk.
- [Payment Optimization](https://www.forter.com/platform/payment-optimization/): Payment authorization and optimization tools to improve approval rates and reduce friction.
- [Chargeback Recovery](https://www.forter.com/platform/chargeback-recovery/): Chargeback handling and recovery services to reduce operational burden and losses.
- [Decision Engine](https://www.forter.com/platform/decision-engine/): Real-time decisioning layer for approving, declining, or reviewing customer actions.

## Use Cases
- [Account Protection](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/account-protection/): Protects logins, account creation, and account changes from takeover and abuse.
- [Payment Fraud](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/payment-fraud/): Detects and prevents fraudulent payment attempts while preserving customer conversion.
- [Returns and Refund Abuse](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/returns-and-refund-abuse/): Identifies abusive return and refund behavior across customer journeys.
- [Promotion Abuse](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/promotion-abuse/): Prevents coupon, loyalty, and promotional abuse without blocking good customers.
- [Marketplace Fraud](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/marketplace-fraud/): Risk controls for buyers, sellers, and transactions in marketplace environments.
- [PSD2 and SCA](https://www.forter.com/use-cases/psd2-sca/): Supports strong customer authentication strategies and exemption optimization.

## Industries
- [Retail](https://www.forter.com/industries/retail/): Fraud and payment decisioning tailored for ecommerce and omnichannel retail brands.
- [Travel](https://www.forter.com/industries/travel/): Risk management for bookings, loyalty abuse, and travel payment flows.
- [Marketplaces](https://www.forter.com/industries/marketplaces/): Identity and fraud controls for multi-sided commerce platforms.
- [Digital Goods](https://www.forter.com/industries/digital-goods/): Protection for instant fulfillment, subscriptions, and digital commerce transactions.
- [Financial Services](https://www.forter.com/industries/financial-services/): Identity and fraud decisioning for financial products and customer onboarding.
- [Food Delivery](https://www.forter.com/industries/food-delivery/): Fraud prevention for high-frequency orders, promotions, and account abuse.
